## 0.8.3

- A friend's stand-in (and its light or power armor frame copy) is disabled first and deleted a second later, never both in one frame. The second test game crashed in a physics job that was still handling a collision with a stand-in freed in the frame it was replaced.
- Protocol 26, as 0.8.0 to 0.8.2. Newer builds are on GitHub first; Nexus follows less often.
